original.target_description: Study 3; between-subjects ANOVA of arousal in response to the high- versus low-saturation red laptop, measured with the nine-point affect grid; 77 undergraduate participants after three incomplete questionnaires were excluded.

n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants included in Study 3 analyses; analytic sample for the target ANOVA.
n.exclusions: 80 recruited; three did not complete questionnaires; 77 analyzed. One self-reported color-blind participant was retained.
